molecules.name: beta-D-xylopyranose
molecules.note: Pentose backbone of softwood arabinoglucuronoxylan (no C6 CH2OH).

molecules.name: alpha-L-arabinofuranose
molecules.note: Furanose (5-membered) side branch of arabinoglucuronoxylan (PubChem CID 7044039).

represents.relation: is the alpha-furanose ring form of

molecules.name: 4-O-methyl-alpha-D-glucuronic acid

represents.relation: is the free-sugar form of the glycosyl unit in

molecules.name: Cellobiose (beta-D-Glcp-(1->4)-D-Glcp)
molecules.note: The cellulose repeating disaccharide; shows the beta-1,4 glycosidic bond.

represents.label: lignocellulose
represents.relation: is a structural fragment of the cellulose component of

molecules.name: Cellotetraose (cellulose, N=4)
molecules.note: Compact cellulose oligomer.

molecules.name: Cellohexaose (cellulose, N=6)
molecules.note: Standard crystalline-cellulose surrogate; twofold-screw ribbon w/ O3-H...O5 H-bonds.

molecules.name: Cellooctaose (cellulose, N=8)
molecules.note: Extended cellulose chain for a longer-ribbon figure.

molecules.name: Galactoglucomannan fragment (compact)
molecules.note: beta-1,4 Man/Glc backbone + alpha-1,6 Gal branch; principal softwood hemicellulose.

molecules.name: Galactoglucomannan fragment (extended, acetylated)
molecules.note: Longer GGM backbone with two Gal branches and native O-acetyl groups.

molecules.name: Arabinoglucuronoxylan fragment (compact)
molecules.note: beta-1,4 xylan backbone + alpha-1,2 MeGlcA + alpha-1,3 arabinofuranose branches.

molecules.name: Arabinoglucuronoxylan fragment (extended)
molecules.note: Longer xylan backbone with multiple acidic and arabinose branches.

molecules.name: p-Coumaryl alcohol (H monolignol)
molecules.note: Trace H units in softwood; included for H/G/S contrast (PubChem CID 5280535).

molecules.name: Coniferyl alcohol (G monolignol)
molecules.note: THE primary softwood (guaiacyl) monolignol (PubChem CID 1549095).

molecules.name: Sinapyl alcohol (S monolignol)
molecules.note: Syringyl monomer; essentially absent from softwood -- caption as the angiosperm contrast (CID 5280507).

molecules.name: Guaiacylglycerol-beta-guaiacyl ether (beta-O-4)
molecules.note: The dominant softwood interunit linkage (~50%); classic beta-O-4 model (PubChem CID 6424189).

molecules.name: Dehydrodiconiferyl alcohol (beta-5 phenylcoumaran)
molecules.note: beta-5 phenylcoumaran dimer, both rings guaiacyl (PubChem CID 5372367).

molecules.name: Pinoresinol (beta-beta resinol)
molecules.note: beta-beta furofuran dimer; also a genuine conifer lignan (keep defined stereo).

represents.label: guaiacyl lignin
represents.relation: is a representative model of the beta-beta linkage in

molecules.name: 5-5' biphenyl diconiferyl alcohol
molecules.note: 5-5 biphenyl C-C linkage (most common softwood C-C bond, often within dibenzodioxocin).

molecules.name: G-(beta-O-4)-G-(beta-5)-G lignin trimer
molecules.note: Defined representative guaiacyl trimer combining beta-O-4 + beta-5 (caption as a model, not bulk lignin).

represents.label: guaiacylglycerol beta-coniferyl ether
represents.relation: shares beta-O-4 guaiacylglycerol ether linkage motif

molecules.name: Dioxygen (O2)
molecules.note: Oxidant in biomass + O2 -> CO2 + H2O (drawn closed-shell; ground state is a triplet diradical).

represents.label: triplet dioxygen
represents.relation: is a closed-shell depiction of the ground-state spin form

molecules.name: Carbon dioxide (CO2)
molecules.note: Combustion product / photosynthesis substrate.

molecules.name: Water (H2O)
molecules.note: Combustion product; the HHV/LHV distinction hinges on its heat of vaporization.

molecules.name: Oleic acid (18:1 cis-9)
molecules.note: Major fatty acid of pine oleoresin/tall oil; cis double bond gives the chain kink.

molecules.name: Palmitic acid (16:0)
molecules.note: Common saturated fatty acid; straight-chain contrast to oleic.

molecules.name: Triolein (glyceryl trioleate)
molecules.note: Representative triacylglyceride (the storage form of 'fats'); three oleate tails on glycerol.

molecules.name: Tripalmitin (glyceryl tripalmitate)
molecules.note: Saturated triacylglyceride alternative.

molecules.name: alpha-Pinene
molecules.note: Dominant Pinus monoterpene; (1S,5S)-(-) enantiomer common in N. American pines (CID 440968).

molecules.name: beta-Pinene
molecules.note: Exocyclic-methylene isomer of alpha-pinene; co-occurs in oleoresin (CID 440967).

molecules.name: Abietic acid
molecules.note: Signature conifer diterpene resin acid (rosin); conjugated 7,13-diene (PubChem CID 10569).

molecules.name: Charcoal — polycyclic aromatic cluster
molecules.note: Representative model: coronene, a small graphene-like fused-aromatic sheet. Real charcoal/pyrogenic carbon is defect-rich, polydisperse fused aromatic clusters with residual O and ash.

molecules.name: Lignite — O-rich coal fragment
molecules.note: Representative model: lowest-rank coal, still lignin-derived — small aromatics with methoxyl, phenol, carboxyl and ether/aliphatic bridges (high O/C). The O-rich end of the rank series.

represents.label: coal
represents.relation: is a representative model fragment of

represents.label: (+)-(7S,8S)-guaiacylglycerol-beta-vanillic acid ether
represents.relation: is a close structural analogue of

molecules.name: Sub-bituminous — intermediate coal fragment
molecules.note: Representative model: a hydroxy-pyrene with a short alkyl chain — larger aromatic unit and far less oxygen than lignite, sitting between lignite and bituminous in rank.

molecules.name: Bituminous — classic coal model fragment
molecules.note: Representative model (Shinn/Wiser-style): fused aromatic clusters linked by short methylene bridges with a hydroaromatic ring and trace oxygen — the hallmark mid-rank coal motif.

molecules.name: Anthracite — near-graphitic aromatic sheet
molecules.note: Representative model: a large peri-fused PAH (circumcoronene class) — highest-rank coal, near-pure fused aromatic carbon approaching graphite (minimal H, ~no O).

represents.label: graphite
represents.relation: is a defect-containing finite-sheet approximation of

molecules.name: Kerogen — Type II (marine) fragment
molecules.note: Representative model: a fused-aromatic core with aliphatic chains, a thiophene (organic sulfur) and a carbonyl — the insoluble organic matter that cracks to petroleum on burial.

represents.label: kerogen
represents.relation: is a representative model fragment of

molecules.name: Crude oil — island asphaltene archetype
molecules.note: Representative model: a 'continental/island' asphaltene (Yen-Mullins) — a polycyclic aromatic core with alkyl chains, the canonical heavy molecule of crude oil (a complex mixture).

molecules.name: UDP-glucose
molecules.note: Activated glucose (a nucleotide sugar): the substrate cellulose synthase polymerizes into β-1,4 glucan. Stereo per ChEBI:46229 (UDP-α-D-glucose).

represents.label: (1->4)-beta-D-glucan
represents.relation: is the activated glucosyl donor of

molecules.name: GDP-mannose (nucleotide sugar)
molecules.note: A nucleotide sugar — the activated mannose donor for softwood galactoglucomannan, built in the Golgi. Stereo per ChEBI:15820 (GDP-α-D-mannose).

represents.label: galactoglucomannan
represents.relation: is the activated mannosyl donor for biosynthesis of

molecules.name: L-Phenylalanine
molecules.note: The aromatic amino acid that enters the phenylpropanoid pathway en route to monolignols (lignin).

molecules.name: Acetyl-CoA
molecules.note: The two-carbon building block: feeds fatty-acid synthesis and the MVA isoprenoid route. Stereo per ChEBI:15351.

molecules.name: Isopentenyl diphosphate (IPP)
molecules.note: The universal C5 isoprene unit; condensed into the prenyl diphosphates that make terpenes/resin.

represents.label: isoprenoid phosphate

represents.label: isoprenoid
represents.relation: is the C5 building-block precursor of

molecules.name: Dimethylallyl diphosphate (DMAPP)
molecules.note: The reactive C5 isomer of IPP that primes prenyl-chain elongation toward terpenes.
